stdout:
Build kit for "dark mode"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
The idea is a part of a page and names no page, so it starts from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
displayName: Top Nav
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

BLOCKS
Ready-made sections for parts the template lacks. Print one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template <name>

name:        MediaThemeLightScrim
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      template
displayName: MediaTheme - Light Scrim
score:       77
reason:      matches 2/2 terms: dark, mode
description: A light scrim over an image. Use MediaTheme mode="light" so text and ghost buttons use dark-on-light tokens.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template MediaThemeLightScrim --type block

name:        MediaThemeImageOverlay
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      template
displayName: MediaTheme - Image Overlay
score:       77
reason:      matches 2/2 terms: dark, mode
description: A common image card pattern: place text and actions over a dark gradient and wrap the overlay content in MediaTheme mode="dark".
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template MediaThemeImageOverlay --type block

name:        CardVariants
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      template
displayName: Card - Variants
score:       77
reason:      matches 2/2 terms: dark, mode
description: Default, muted, and color variants side by side. Use color variants to categorize cards visually, like team colors, project tags, or content types. Each color uses the corresponding background token from the theme, so they adapt to light and dark mode automatically.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template CardVariants --type block

name:        PopoverSettingsPanel
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      template
displayName: Popover - Settings Panel
score:       77
reason:      matches 2/2 terms: dark, mode
description: Popover with toggle switches for managing user preferences like notifications, dark mode, and sounds.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template PopoverSettingsPanel --type block

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover. Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

name:        useImageMode
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      hook
score:       159
reason:      matches 2/2 terms: dark, mode
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Detects whether an image is predominantly dark or light by sampling pixels via OffscreenCanvas. Uses APCA perceptual lightness (sRGB linearization + power curve) for accurate detection, especially on saturated colors. Runs entirely off the paint path: no visible canvas, no layout thrash. Supports regional sampling for detecting luminance where text overlays will appear. Returns null while loading and falls back gracefully on CORS or network errors.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useImageMode

name:        useTheme
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      hook
score:       159
reason:      matches 2/2 terms: dark, mode
import:      @astryxdesign/core/theme
description: Programmatic access to theme tokens for non-CSS consumers like SVG, canvas, Vega, D3, maps, or chart libraries that need values in JavaScript instead of CSS custom property references.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useTheme
